text:
rachel: follow-up from the midnight throughput incident. want to lock owners/timelines for remediation, SLO handling, and a retro on the recurring pattern. summary: p99 spikes during nightly rollout window, throughput collapse, autoscaler slow to react.
omar: numbers?
rachel: p95 ~180ms, p99 up to 1.6s for ~25m (00:50-01:15 UTC). throughput fell from 120rps -> 22rps. weekly error-budget burn now at ~16%. happened 3x in last 5 weeks.
chun: looks correlated with batch-job alignment + model-pool churn. also saw increased cold-starts after drain events.
opsbot: incident-3198765432 created: https://incidents.redwood/3198765432 01: severity=P2, linked to "throughput-regressions".
rachel: proposed immediate decisions: 1) do NOT loosen global SLOs 2) apply a scheduled tolerance window only for alerting + temporary route-level fallback behavior during 00:30-01:30 UTC until mitigations land 3) owners and deadlines for fixes.
omar: agree on windowed alert tolerance. prefer route-level graceful degradation over changing SLA numbers. CS/infra need to weigh in.
cs-jules: customer note: if we only change alerting and a limited fallback route, we can avoid SLA amendments for most customers. but if fallback hits for >1h cumulative we'll draft a notice.
chun: remediation plan (short): A) dashboard split by warm/cold + per-customer SLA widget (Omar) B) autoscaler cooldown tuning + pre-warm hooks (Infra-lead) C) route-level fallback to lightweight model when p99>900ms for 2m (Rachel) D) batch-job jitter to avoid alignment (Infra) E) error-budget projection panel (Omar).
rachel: owners + deadlines: Omar - dashboard + error-budget projection + per-customer widget by Wed EOD; Infra-lead - pre-warm + autoscaler tweak PR by Mon; Chun - fallback route prototype by Tue, canary Wed; Rachel - runbook + SLO policy note + exec one-pager by Thu.
omar: dashboard query draft I'll add:
```
# p99 by instance warm state and route fallback flag
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(request_latency_seconds_bucket{route="/v1/generate"}[5m])) by (le, instance_warm, route_fallback))
```
chun: fallback plan: if p99>900ms for 2m, mark route as degraded and route 30% traffic to lite-model; only escalate to pager if degraded route + error budget burn > 5%/day.
infra-lead: pre-warm plan: add pre-warm hook to pool-manager and keep a small sticky pool during rollout windows. will open PR today, aim for staging canary Thu 00:30 and prod Fri 00:30.
opsbot: action items recorded on incident checklist: Omar(dashboard), Infra-lead(pre-warm), Chun(fallback), Rachel(runbook). Deadlines logged.
omar: will also add an error-budget projection panel: current burn rate * 24h => days-to-zero and a table showing top 10 customers by SLA headroom.
cs-jules: please include a short sample customer message in the exec one-pager so CS can use it if we need to notify.
rachel: decision check 1: keep SLOs unchanged, implement alerting tolerance window and fallback route until fixes. react with :thumbsup: to approve.
omar: :thumbsup:
chun: :thumbsup:
infra-lead: :thumbsup:
cs-jules: :thumbsup:
rachel: ok moving forward. small follow-ups: - Omar add pager suppression rule: only page if p99>900ms AND queue_length>threshold. - Infra raise a follow ticket if pre-warm increases cost > 8% so we can review with finance. - Chun add regression test for cold-start bursts.
omar: noted, I'll add the suppression rule and the top-10 customer widget.
infra-lead: will measure cost delta in staging and add to PR description.
chun: regression test will be part of CI for pool-manager change, tagging perf CI.
opsbot: scheduling note 1: staging canary Wed 00:30, prod canary Fri 00:30; owners will update statuses in incident tracker.
rachel: thanks all. I'll post the exec one-pager this afternoon. if anything blocks owners please flag here and we'll escalate. :eyes:
